propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for inspecting held or orphaned locks; operators cannot learn lock holder identity, process liveness, or hold duration without manual filesystem inspection

rebar doctor must report four lock legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent state and stamp metadata (host, namespace, pid, start time) for the mkdir leg only
rebar doctor must determine holder liveness and lock staleness using only the existing lock_owner module functions, with no independent staleness heuristic or pid probe invented
a stale-lock finding must trigger exit code 1 and join doctor's findings list; a held lock with a live holder must remain INFO-level and not affect exit code
rebar doctor lock diagnostics must be read-only: no lock state is mutated, reclaimed, or deleted by doctor or --repair
